extracted.name: Puff puff snack mini Balls
extracted.description: Great recipe for Puff puff snack mini Balls.
instruction_lines: Mix the ingredients into a bowl
Make sure the dough is thick and bit light like cake mixture
Then cover to rise for 30 minutes
In a warm oil start cutting into little balls with your hands
